payload.description: PR #66 landed the intra-component lineage detector: data-flows recall 0->1/158, precision 1/48 (47 false positives). Tighten emission to reduce FPs while keeping the 1 TP (pocketbase-password-to-bcrypt-hash) and not regressing other layers. Investigate the 47 FPs by repo (ghost 10, pocketbase 7, directus/keycloak/posthog-user/saleor/strapi 4 each, etc.). Likely candidates: pattern specificity, dedupe, disposition gating. Measure against the pinned baseline; recall must not drop below 1/158, precision should rise. Do not change gold.
payload.title: Tighten intra-component flow detection precision (47 FPs at 1 TP)
